title: Reasoning Models From Scratch: Code Setup
excerpt: A short video on how conventional LLMs relate to reasoning models and agents, along with Python and PyTorch setup using uv.
content_html:
A little video that

  • explains the relationship between conventional LLMs and reasoning models (and agents),
  • philosophizes about “from scratch” approaches,
  • and explains how to install the Python and PyTorch requirements with uv.

The video is here: Build A Reasoning Model From Scratch #1: Motivation & Code Setup.

Source: website version of my Substack note.
